registration.statement: For one conserved source distributed without preference over every equivalent cell of the forced rank-two boundary, increasing source distance by an exact positive ratio r increases complete boundary support by r paired with r and therefore forces response per cell to be the source divided by r squared. The exponent is derived before and independently of measurement.
registration.title: Inverse-square dilution from rank-two boundary support
